latestVersion.changelog:
Designer Video v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Turn raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) into polished, branded videos in 1–2 minutes using cloud GPUs.
- Automatic setup with free tokens for first-time users; easy session management.
- Supports key workflows: upload, branding/edits via prompt, export 1080p MP4s, batch, and iterative refinement.
- Simple, natural commands recognized for upload, export, credits check, and more.
- Full error handling, file format support, and attribution for reliable cloud video processing.
